'''smilingjoker525 jedi drainer''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[smilingjoker525]]
* '''Published:''' 5 June 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' jedi drainer
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 JD smilingjoker525 LS 2004 GPN.txt |Download]] (omits Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Demotion (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

pull out jedi to drain them with lightsabers and let ships fight in space

== Notes ==

* No objective; starting interrupt Heading For The Medical Frigate with Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Get To Your Ships!, Colo Claw Fish and Naboo: Theed Palace Generator Core.
* 'Admirals Orders' in the Effect list read as a sub-header for Taking Them With Us (total 60 without it).
* Posted 'Naboo: theed power chamber' dested Naboo: Theed Palace Generator (unsure); 'Red 4' Red Squadron 4; 'Red 5 with Artoo' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Battle Plans & Draws their Fire' Battle Plan & Draw Their Fire.
* Original-era (V) slips: Sai'torr Kal Fas (VS1), Demotion (VS2).

== Strategy ==

well i made this deck as my first deck more like my fun deck i know it would need some major work but tell me what u think. i thought if u have opponents with non-space themes ur jedi can walk around sweeping through. and in space well i added i guess enough to fight there too. use some of the inturupts and effects to alter or enhance ur destiny so anything in ur way can get plowed over, i hope it works my friend wants to make the deck but i need some help on ajusting it to hurt a lot more. most of the jedi should get there lightsabers when they come into play plus u can use some ships that are suped up to kill some other guys. the jedi's get there lightsabers and drain for a few. they might not get stepped up to unless someone has a army or dark jedi but u have destiny draws that are rediculous to not let em lose the fight
